relaunchReasons.gatemcp: Re-launch from your MCP client by reconnecting this server. The client owns its stdio process.
relaunchReasons.reader: No isolated safe restart is verified. Stop the backend in its owning terminal before using the startup chain.

removalReasons.gameeditor: Remove this editor version through Game Hub. Projects and licenses must be kept separately.
removalReasons.coder: Native installation: no complete settings-preserving uninstall has been verified. Shared integrations are left untouched.
removalReasons.helper: The agent environment lives beside personal configuration. No safe automated uninstall is verified.
removalReasons.gate: Gate HTTP and MCP share an environment and model assets. Remove them together manually after reviewing dependents.
removalReasons.gatemcp: This client shares the Gate installation. Remove its entry in your MCP client settings first.
removalReasons.reader: The backend, frontend and data services share this source checkout. No isolated uninstall has been verified.
removalReasons.shelf: The source checkout contains your bookmark database. No automated removal is offered to protect your library.
removalReasons.imgup: Model files, runtimes and launcher scripts may be shared. No removal script is offered.
removalReasons.imgdraft: Model files, runtimes and launcher scripts may be shared. No removal script is offered.
removalReasons.router: Source checkout plus a private runtime; the database holds your encrypted provider keys. No removal script is offered.
removalReasons.auditor: Source checkout with a local launcher script; there is no packaged uninstall. No removal script is offered.
